authors_reviews.title: Family fun activity.
authors_reviews.text: I enjoyed doing these with my Granddaughter. She loves sticker activities and these Halloween characters were a lot of fun. They are easy to apply and have a variety of designs. I was impressed with the quality and I think it is a good value for the money. Any characters we don’t use, I will probably put in my trick or treat bowl.
authors_reviews.author: Danielle W

authors_reviews.title: My Daughter Absolutely Loved These!
authors_reviews.text: My daughter absolutely loved these Thanksgiving stickers! She was so excited when they arrived and immediately wanted to start creating. The variety of stickers in this set is fantastic - there are so many different turkey faces, feathers, decorations, and accessories that she could make each turkey completely unique. The quality of the stickers is excellent - they're colorful, vibrant, and stuck well to paper without being difficult to peel or reposition. We spent hours together making different turkey characters, and she was so proud of her creations. She made turkeys for all her grandparents and even decorated placecards for our Thanksgiving table. The stickers sparked her creativity and kept her entertained for a long time, which as a parent is priceless! The set provided great value with plenty of stickers for multiple craft sessions. It was a wonderful hands-on activity that got her excited about the holiday. She loved mixing and matching the different features to give each turkey its own personality. These stickers are perfect for Thanksgiving crafts, classroom activities, or just creative play. My daughter asks to use them constantly and has already requested more craft sticker sets. Highly recommend for any parent looking for engaging, creative activities!
authors_reviews.author: Palmetto Dan

authors_reviews.title: Perfect to entertain my grandkids
authors_reviews.text: I bought these for when my grandkids come over, and they absolutely love them. There are plenty of different animal faces to choose from, so they have fun picking out which stickers they want each visit. The colors are bright, they’re easy to peel, and they’ve been a great little activity to keep on hand. I’d definitely buy them again.
